condition: normal training Memory log-occupancy ridge regression from current/SOC; target control excluded
q_only_control: identical architecture and parameter count; Memory coordinates held at normal training mean
training_mask: one whole target variable sampled uniformly per window; same schedule across heads
validation_and_scoring: all targets and all time points, full normal validation/test cohort
loss: signed calibrated residual sequence LOO Huber
relation_error_scale: median normal training per-window MAE by variable, floor 1e-5
fusion_stage: after existing Top5 aggregation, at decision-object level
